items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: Howard Mandorf, he's doing the same. He's good musicians, good entertaining musicians. He's all in Los Angeles.

ctx.x: I think, I don't know, it was Andrew Morgan. Someone was telling me that they breathe through their nose at the same time they're blowing through their mouth.

Yeah, that's something funny there. Yeah. But he do it. I mean, Sam was the first one. Sam L.A. And I said, you went to Los Angeles, and you have to be there six months, you know, before you get on a regular job. But he's spotted. And them guys just have one club. They're one from each club. And he's down in Santa Monica. The last I seen him was in 58. I was out there. And he said, he'd been out there three years, and he's still there. Howard Mandorf, he's doing the same. He's good musicians, good entertaining…
Have you been out to Los Angeles again since the war, or California since the war?
